title: Regions
description: content/regions.json: Leonida's state, counties, headline regions, districts, towns, islands and water. A region needs at least one source URL or one evidence find (the validator enforces this).

parent.description: Containing region id. Only the state has null. Unknown county means parent is the state, with the conflict in notes.

vibe.description: Only tags a source supports. The game has no official danger or wealth rating.

vibe_note.description: The sourced wording behind the vibe tags.

real_world_analogue.description: Only when a source states it. Research inferences go in notes.

research_ref.description: Where in research/ this region is described.

evidence_finds.description: Finds whose region_ids include this region. Must match exactly.
